name: native-capacitor-push-android
//: The plugin's Kotlin and Java module, split from the TypeScript project native-capacitor-push so that Nx maps these files here (the deepest project root owns a file). Owned by the TypeScript project, a native-only edit marked every TypeScript dependent affected; trinity-android reaches this project through an implicit dependency instead, so the edit still marks the Android host and the checks that depend on it. An .nxignore entry would not do: Nx drops ignored files from affected and hashing altogether, the Android host included.
